signals.usability_note: Clear view of a single-story ranch-style house across a large front lawn, partially framed by tree canopy.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds with small shrubs and arborvitae near the house, but this looks homeowner-maintained with no crew or equipment visible.
